5.5 Acceptance of late or partial payment shall not:
(a) Constitute a waiver of any breach;
(b) Create a new payment arrangement;
(c) Prevent recovery of the remaining balance; or
(d) Prevent the Landlord from exercising any lawful remedy.

6.10 No deduction or recovery shall entitle the Landlord to recover the same loss twice.
